name: Form item (web component)
summary: One labelled, validated field with no antd: the label, a required mark, help text and the error row around one DS control, wired to it for screen readers.
highlights: Label, required mark, help and error around one control
Names, describes and marks invalid the slotted control
lead: The framework-free Form.Item. It wraps ONE control (any <aha-*> field, or a native input, select or textarea) and draws what antd's Form.Item draws under form-theme.js, value for value: the label above (14/22 regular ink, 4 below), an ink * before the label of a required field, the error row below the field (the shared <aha-field-error icon>: 12px warning-circle glyph and 12/18 ink text, never a status hue) and the help line under it (<aha-field-error tone="info">, 12/18 secondary), 20 below the item. It wires itself to the control across the shadow boundary the way the DS fields already do: the label becomes the control's aria-label (unless the control names itself), required sets aria-required, an error sets status="error" on an <aha-*> control (its error border and aria-invalid) or aria-invalid on a native one, and the error and help nodes sit in the item's light DOM with stable ids listed in the control's aria-describedby, which <aha-input>, <aha-counted-input>, <aha-counted-textarea> and <aha-select> resolve onto their inner field. Clicking the label focuses the control. Use it inside <aha-form>, or alone with validate().
codeNote: Attributes: label, name, required, required-message (default "This field is required"), help, error. Properties: validator (value, { values, item }) => message | '' | Promise; a thrown Error's message counts as the message. Methods: validate() resolves to the message ('' when valid) and shows it; reset() restores the control's first value; focus(). Getters: control, value (the control's value; checked for <aha-checkbox>, <aha-switch> and a native checkbox; values for <aha-select mode="tags">), message. Empty for required means '', whitespace only, an empty list or unchecked. It validates when the field is left after an edit and on every edit while an error shows. `error` is the consumer's own message (a server answer): it shows until removed and never blocks submit; a validation error shows over it. In React 18 set validator through a ref, and leave `required` out rather than passing false (React 18 writes required="false", which still counts).

spec.label: Label
spec.value: 14/22 regular ink (text-default), above the control, 4 below; wraps; hidden when there is no label

spec.label: Required mark
spec.value: an ink * (text-negative, the default ink) 4 before the label; aria-hidden, the control carries aria-required

spec.label: Optional mark
spec.value: with required-mark="optional" on the form: "(optional)" in text-secondary 4 after the label of a field that is not required

spec.label: Error
spec.value: <aha-field-error icon> 4 below the control: 12px warning-circle glyph + 12/18 ink text, the control takes its error border; never a status hue

spec.label: Spacing
spec.value: 20 below each item (antd itemMarginBottom); a text control, select or textarea fills the item width

spec.label: Horizontal
spec.value: label in a 160 column (--aha-form-label-width), centred on the 40 control row, 16 to the control; stacked under 576 wide (antd)

spec.label: Inline
spec.value: label and control on one row, 8 apart, no bottom margin; the control keeps its own width

props.name: label
props.desc: Visible label; also the control's accessible name when the control has no aria-label

props.name: name
props.desc: The key of this field in the form's values

props.name: required
props.desc: Empty fails validation; shows the * and sets aria-required on the control

props.name: required-message
props.desc: The error for an empty required field; pass translated text

props.name: help
props.desc: Muted help line under the field, linked through aria-describedby (antd extra)

props.name: error
props.desc: A message you own, such as a server answer; shows until removed and never blocks submit (antd help + validateStatus)

props.name: validator
props.desc: Property. Runs after the required check on a non-empty value; return '' when valid

props.name: validate()
props.desc: Runs the rules, shows the result, resolves to the message

props.name: reset()
props.desc: Restores the control's first value and clears the validation error

props.name: value
props.desc: The control's value (checked for a checkbox or switch, values for a tags select)

whenToUse.when: a labelled field with a required mark, help or validation, from code that cannot reach antd's Form.Item
a React or Vue 3 app that already themes antd with form-theme.js
a settings surface: label left, control right, saved as it changes, no submit
a labelled field on the audience phone, in the deck ink

opinion.note: Label every field with a noun phrase. Write the required message as what to do ("Enter a project name") when the generic one is not clear enough. Help says what the field is for or the format it takes; it is not a second label.

snippets.note: The native form: a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, no build step.
